endorsements.name: Andrew MacPherson
endorsements.label: Uncovering useful and embarrassing info with Maltego
endorsements.description: Standby Speakers at in 45 minutes | Demo Andrew MacPherson Ops/Dev - Paterva The talk has two sections - useful and embarrassing. In the 'useful' section of this fun filled talk we show how we combine the power of Maltego and Shodan to hunt for ICS devices on the Internet. We tackle the difficult problem of finding the function, owners and locations of these devices using OSINT and Maltego. The result is a one click sequence of transforms that makes finding interesting ICS devices child's play. In the 'embarrassing' section we look at how network footprinting (which we've refined to an art in Maltego) becomes useful for identifying and profiling people who's job description involves lots of lies and who probably does not want to be associated with the data that's out there on them.
